meta.name: tax
meta.description: Structures the tax questions a growing business faces — corporate income, sales and use, payroll, nexus, and the obligations created by hiring or selling somewhere new. Use this to work out what a new state or country obligates you to, prepare for a tax filing or audit, understand sales tax on your product, or check what a remote hire or new market triggers.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 梳理公司各项税务问题,为报税审计做好准备
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的公司正拓展新市场或雇佣异地员工,需要搞清税务责任。
copy.tagline_en: Clarify your company's tax obligations before filing or expanding.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your growing business faces tax compliance questions across states or countries.

howto.what: 它会帮你梳理企业税务问题:按企业所得税、销售税、工资税、nexus(纳税关联)等类别,列出你在新地点雇佣或销售时可能产生的申报义务,并提醒你该问什么、什么时候报税。
howto.when: 当你准备报税或审计、想了解产品是否要收销售税、或新招了远程员工/进入新市场时,它会触发并帮你梳理相关纳税义务。

say.text: 我刚在德州雇了一个远程员工,要办哪些税务登记?
say.note: 它会列出州的nexus和登记事项。

say.text: 我的SaaS产品在纽约州卖,要收销售税吗?
say.note: 它会告诉你按什么标准判定。

say.text: 这个月要报州税,帮我把申报日历列出来。
say.note: 它会按州列出申报义务和日历。

howto.what_en: It structures a growing business's tax questions — corporate income, sales/use, payroll, nexus — and lists obligations from hiring or selling somewhere new, telling you what to ask and when to file.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you prepare for a tax filing or audit, want to understand sales tax on your product, or check what a remote hire or new market obligates you to.

say_en.text: I just hired a remote employee in Texas. What tax registrations do I need?
say_en.note: It lists nexus and registration items.

say_en.text: Is my SaaS product subject to sales tax in New York?
say_en.note: It tells you the criteria to decide.

say_en.text: This month's state tax is due. Help me list the filing calendar.
say_en.note: It lists obligations by state with dates.
